title: SAD chief assailant a law graduate, ran snacks centre in Pune: Police

title: In Massachusetts, obsolete dam demolition begins after 14-year effort
content: the Temple Street Dam in duxbury, Massachusetts, had long outlived its purpose . it blocked fish from reaching their spawning grounds, trapped sediment and disrupted the South River's natural hydrology . in 2012, conservationists began working to change that, fourteen years later, in 2026, demolition finally started .

title: 'Uncalled for': CJI pulls up Bar Council of India over threat of action against NALSAR students
content:
CJI Surya Kant (File photo)

NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Friday expressed “strong disapproval” of the Bar Council of India’s (BCI) now-revoked order barring the enrolment of 2026 graduates of Hyderabad’s NALSAR University of Law as advocates after a section of students objected to the university inviting Chief Justice of India Surya Kant as the chief guest at its convocation ceremony. Kant, heading a bench also comprising Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, said students have a right to protest peacefully and described the episode as a “dialogue” between him and the students. "If students are protesting peacefully, who is BCI to take action? It is the right of the students to protest peacefully. It is a dialogue between students and me. No one else has to step in," the CJI said.(Developing story)

title: US sends new carrier to Middle East amid reports of mental health crisis on USS Lincoln
content: the carrier swap is part of a previously planned rotation . concerns over crew morale and conditions aboard the Lincoln have raised questions . the move comes as families and lawmakers have raised alarm over reports that sailors have experienced severe burnout and deteriorating living conditions after more than 250 days at sea .

title: 'A moment that tore apart several lives': PM Modi on Partition Horrors Remembrance Day
